claim_groups.claim_group: Required EPSG:4326 to EPSG:3857 lon/lat-degree constructor and call contract
claim_groups.artifact_locations: X final recommendation; Y final recommendation; X intermediates 1-2; Y intermediates 2-4

X.assessment: always_xy=True at creation and degree input with radians=False/FORWARD are correct; error policy is explicit.

Y.assessment: Same configuration/call is correct; rejecting radians=True for degree-encoded input is justified.

claim_groups.claim_group: Construction, maker/thread-local and scalar/array consuming-call trace; signatures
claim_groups.artifact_locations: X F1-F2; Y finding 1; X intermediates 1-2; Y intermediate 1 §1, intermediate 2 §1, intermediate 3 E1

X.assessment: Python creation and call trace is sufficient for this bounded brief; the Cython body is acknowledged as absent. It does not trace both transform branches in detail.

Y.assessment: Exact signatures, flag passthrough and scalar/array branches are supported. Constructor checks TransformerMaker generally, not an exclusive enumeration of all public constructors.

claim_groups.claim_group: Caller order separated from native CRS axes; default behavior and frozen metadata gap
claim_groups.artifact_locations: X F3; Y finding 2; all substantive intermediates

X.assessment: The two frozen files do not contain the EPSG axis registry. Conditional native-order treatment is honest, rather than proof that the axis order is unknowable. Reviewer primary data confirms 4326 latitude then longitude.

Y.assessment: Same separation and justified two-file metadata limitation. Correctly ordered native tuples remain valid with always_xy=False.

claim_groups.claim_group: always_xy meaning, both endpoints, default False, geographic/projected scope and limitations
claim_groups.artifact_locations: X F3-F4; Y finding 3; X intermediates 1-2; Y intermediate 1 §3, intermediate 2 §3, intermediate 3 E2

X.assessment: GIS ordering on both ends and most-projected qualifier are preserved. It does not validate ranges or set angular encoding/accuracy.

Y.assessment: Both endpoint ordering and default are correct. Absence of a statement in the frozen files is not a general proof of unrelated dependency behavior; the final appropriately calls it absence.

claim_groups.claim_group: itransform switch is separate; deprecated from_proj/module paths
claim_groups.artifact_locations: X F4/F2; Y findings 1/3 and rejected claims; Y intermediates 1-3

X.assessment: switch is a per-iteration flag distinct from constructor ordering; transform method has no always_xy parameter.

Y.assessment: Deprecation and passthrough are real. Rejection is a recommendation against deprecated APIs, not evidence they cannot work. switch does not generally reproduce normalized input and output order for this pair.

claim_groups.claim_group: Radians: angular inputs/outputs versus linear projected domains; pipeline and worked examples
claim_groups.artifact_locations: X F5; Y finding 4 L59-64; X intermediates 1-2 F5; Y intermediate 1 §4, intermediate 2 §4, intermediate 3 E3

X.assessment: Correct for this geographic degree input, but final shorthand radians=False means degrees should explicitly remain scoped to geographic/angular coordinates. It does not say non-geographic output becomes degrees.

Y.assessment: The added else degrees after if geographic is false for projected output. The flag changes geographic angular encoding, not 3857 linear units. This error recurs through required intermediates 1-3.

claim_groups.claim_group: EPSG:3857 output units, geocentric/metre text and introspection claims
claim_groups.artifact_locations: X F5/P4; Y finding 5 and units sections in intermediates

X.assessment: It is true no frozen sentence explicitly declares 3857 metres. Conditioning metres and proposing axis_info/target_crs is legitimate; still distinguish projected linear units from radians/degrees. Released PROJ data independently resolves metre units.

Y.assessment: The corpus gap itself is genuine and geocentric/z wording is faithfully reported as source text, not a 3857 proof. Deferring units does not neutralize finding 4's false projected-degree implication. No runtime witness is necessary merely to read released CRS unit metadata.

claim_groups.claim_group: AOI, authority, accuracy, ballpark, force_over, only_best, environment/ini and version gates
claim_groups.artifact_locations: X F6/F8; Y finding 6/8; required intermediates' selection sections

X.assessment: AOI helps selection; ballpark allowed by default; only_best hypothetical accessible-grid condition and PROJ 9.2 gate are cited; unknown accuracy=-1 supported.

Y.assessment: Authority/accuracy/ballpark and 9/9.1/9.2 gates, plus only_best environment/ini override, are supported. No source proves particular grids or operation choice for the actual host.

claim_groups.claim_group: Candidate ordering, available/unavailable operations, accuracy/area/use and operation/network introspection
claim_groups.artifact_locations: X F6/P6; Y finding 6 and introspection proposals; required intermediates

X.assessment: Group sorting/availability are supported. P6 should obtain accuracy from each group.transformers member, not assume a group.accuracy property.

Y.assessment: Group ordering is accurately summarized. operations is for a concatenated operation and can be absent; get_last_used_operation is version gated and must follow a transform. Listing hooks is not proof of a selected operation.

claim_groups.claim_group: Area-of-use and invalid-input/error handling limits, including structural validation
claim_groups.artifact_locations: X F6/F7 and O5 partial; Y finding 6/7; X intermediates 1-2; Y intermediate 1 §5, intermediate 2 §5, intermediate 3 E4

X.assessment: Reported-error inf/raise contract is correct; one success cannot establish area validity. Missing explicit distinction: AOI is selection guidance, not a range fence; errcheck is not semantic coordinate/finite-output validation. Merely lacking a numerical range table is not itself an error.

Y.assessment: Same missing selection-versus-validation distinction despite correct hooks and iterable structure rules. No generic finiteness check follows the transformation. Numeric registry area, mathematical pole singularity and application acceptance must be distinguished.

claim_groups.claim_group: Single-city success, source examples and unsupported extrapolation
claim_groups.artifact_locations: X F7/P7; Y finding 7; X intermediates 1-2; Y intermediate 1 §6, intermediate 2 §6, intermediate 3 E5

X.assessment: Plausible magnitude is not an independent location/unit oracle; one success does not establish error, edge, inverse or dependency behavior. Source (33,98) uses default order; it is not evidence that documented lon/lat (33,98) is valid.

Y.assessment: Same limits are supported. Primary metadata and arithmetic identify the example as latitude 33/longitude 98, rather than latitude 98. Separate identity inference is assessed in G20.

claim_groups.claim_group: Axis-pair proposed check and its prediction
claim_groups.artifact_locations: X P1 (final L37; intermediate-1 L41; intermediate-2 embedded P1); Y final L114-115 and intermediate-3 L40; Y intermediate-1 seeds/intermediate-2 proposal

X.assessment: For a chosen unequal pair with both readings plausible, same raw pair under True/False differs. A comparison needs an independent expected location, not just different numbers.

Y.assessment: Not only True+(lon,lat) matches: False+(lat,lon) matches the same point too. At (2°,49°), both correctly ordered cases yield derived (222638.98158654713,6274861.394006575) metres. No pyproj runtime was executed.

claim_groups.claim_group: Unit-confusion proposed check and its prediction
claim_groups.artifact_locations: X P2 in final/intermediates 1-2; Y final L116-117 and intermediate-3 L41; Y intermediate-1/2 proposals

X.assessment: Only one sane is ambiguous over the four encoding/flag combinations: degrees+False and converted radians+True both represent the same point. Mismatched encodings can also remain finite/plausible. If intended per fixed encoding, exactly one matching flag is correct; that qualifier/oracle is absent.

Y.assessment: A fixed degree-encoded point under False versus True is misread by True. Choose a nonzero discriminating point and independently known output; finiteness alone cannot discriminate units.

claim_groups.claim_group: Proposed invalid-input errcheck comparison
claim_groups.artifact_locations: X P3; Y final L121-122; required intermediates' error proposals

X.assessment: Latitude 98 degrees in the correct input slot violates the mathematical latitude domain and is a reasonable reported-transform-error witness. No claim of executing it is made. Shape/type exceptions are not suppressed by errcheck=False.

Y.assessment: The proposed reported-transformation-error comparison is sound; invalid input must be specified to trigger a reported projection error. A wrong-but-valid swapped/unit-misread point need not raise.

claim_groups.claim_group: Bounds, densification, antimeridian and geographic-destination governing condition
claim_groups.artifact_locations: X P5; Y final L90/L123-124; Y intermediate-3 E4 L32; other intermediates' bounds locators

X.assessment: Boundary/near-pole/antimeridian exploration is appropriate. The cited right<left polygon rule is only for geographic destination output; forward 3857 is projected. X does not directly assert the unrestricted rule.

Y.assessment: Intermediate-3 E4 states right<left implies two polygons without the source's geographic-destination condition. It does not apply generally to projected 3857 output. Final bounds proposals do not correct that intermediate claim.

claim_groups.claim_group: Optional checks and dependency/environment uncertainty
claim_groups.artifact_locations: X P4/P6/P7/P8,F8; Y findings 6/8, checks 3/6 and uncertainty; all substantive intermediates

X.assessment: CRS/unit introspection, group audit, forward/inverse tolerance and environment recording are useful proposed checks; a round trip alone cannot prove label or unit correctness. PROJ 9.3 is assumed, never established as installed.

Y.assessment: Operation/bounds/environment proposals are supported and not executed. Cython/registry gaps were genuinely outside the candidates' frozen corpus. Only observable via hooks is too exclusive if read as a universal claim: frozen grid-download docs also mention debug logs.

claim_groups.claim_group: Semantic preservation, accepted/amended/rejected/unresolved dispositions
claim_groups.artifact_locations: X ledgers and intermediate-2 embedded final; Y handoffs, final dispositions and intermediate-4

X.assessment: Core contract, explicit uncertainties, examples, negative scope and P1-P8 are carried forward. Intermediate-1 geographic qualifier on default degrees is weakened in the final, and P2 ambiguity is preserved. No source-linked substantive rejection was required to manufacture a different recommendation.

Y.assessment: Correct constructor/deprecated/radian-input/switch distinctions and uncertainties survive. The else degrees and unique-correct-axis prediction survive into final; the bounds antecedent and identity inference remain defects in required intermediate-3. Omission of an intermediate error is not evidence it was scientifically corrected.

claim_groups.claim_group: Source IDs, release/capture claims, cited ranges and apparent verification assurances
claim_groups.artifact_locations: X Sources/claim ledger; Y frozen sources/line references/uncertainty; all required intermediates
